Job Description
Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune
We are looking for an Identity & Access Governance Engineer with strong experience in cloud identity governance, modern authentication and enterprise IGA. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Microsoft Entra ID or comparable cloud identity platforms, with experience across access governance, Conditional Access, SSO/federation, MFA, passwordless authentication, hybrid identity and application integrations. A solid understanding of SailPoint and identity lifecycle governance is required. The role will also contribute to identity modernization, NHI governance, automation and AI-powered IAM capabilities.
Responsibilities:
Cloud Identity & Governance
Design, implement and continuously improve cloud identity governance and access controls.
Manage identity governance across users, groups, roles, applications and privileged identities.
Define and maintain RBAC and least-privilege models.
Review identity architecture and identify governance, security and operational gaps.
Support identity modernization and cloud/platform transformation initiatives.
Establish scalable governance standards that can operate across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Entra ID & Modern Authentication
Manage and enhance Microsoft Entra ID identity and access capabilities.
Design and govern Conditional Access policies.
Support MFA, Passwordless, Passkeys/FIDO2 and modern authentication.
Govern enterprise applications, application registrations, service principals and permissions.
Support identity risk, privileged access and access hygiene improvements.
Support AD and Entra hybrid identity environments.
NHI & AI-Agent Identity Governance
Drive discovery and governance of Non-Human Identities, including service accounts, service principals, managed identities, workload identities and application identities.
Support discovery and inventory of AI agents and autonomous identities.
Define governance requirements around ownership, lifecycle and access for AI agents and NHIs.
Review roles, permissions and entitlements assigned to AI agents and machine identities.
Apply appropriate least-privilege and access-review principles to human, machine and agent identities.
Identify unmanaged, orphaned, stale or over-privileged NHIs and help drive remediation.
Help establish governance models for the growing use of AI agents and machine-to-machine identities.
Automation & AI-Powered IAM
Automate IAM/IGA activities using PowerShell, REST APIs, scripting and workflow automation.
Identify opportunities to use AI-powered automation for identity governance and operational activities.
Automate identity discovery, governance reporting, lifecycle processes and control validation where appropriate.
Help build scalable and repeatable identity governance processes rather than relying on manual administration.
Qualifications
Must have: Strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Entra ID / cloud identity governance, including Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless/passkeys, RBAC and application identities.
Strong Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) knowledge, including JML, provisioning/deprovisioning, access reviews, roles and entitlement governance.
Working knowledge of SailPoint and enterprise identity governance processes.

Job TitleSoftware Technologist - DevOps

Job Description
Minimum required Education:
Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent.

Job title:
Senior Technologist - Devops

Your role:
Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern version control and automation platforms (e.g., GitHub or similar). 
Build and operate cloud-native platforms using container orchestration, infrastructure as code, and managed cloud services. 
Enable development and test teams through self-service tools, standardized workflows, and platform capabilities that improve velocity and quality. 
Define and implement reusable CI/CD and infrastructure patterns across teams. 
Integrate security controls into pipelines (e.g., code scanning, dependency management, secrets handling) and enforce secure delivery practices. 
Ensure systems and processes meet regulatory and compliance requirements, including required controls and documentation.  
Troubleshoot production incidents, lead root cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes to improve reliability.  
Drive measurable improvements in deployment frequency, lead time, and system availability through automation and optimization. 
Implement and maintain observability practices including monitoring, alerting, and logging.  
Lead cross-team initiatives, mentor engineers, and guide adoption of DevOps best practices. 
Participate in on-call support for 24x7 production systems and global deployments.  
Be prepared to discuss specific implementations, trade-offs, and production challenges personally led or resolved. 

You're the right fit if:
5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Site Reliability, or cloud engineering supporting production SaaS systems  
Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS or equivalent) and distributed, containerized systems  
Experience building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using modern automation platforms (e.g., GitHub and GitHub Actions or similar)  
Experience implementing cloud security best practices, including secrets management and pipeline security  
Proficiency in automation and scripting for infrastructure and operational workflows  
Exposure to AI-assisted engineering and modern development workflows  
Experience working in Agile environments (e.g., SAFe or similar frameworks)  
Strong troubleshooting skills across complex production systems  
Business acumen with the ability to align technical solutions to product and operational goals  
Experience working in regulated environments (e.g., healthcare or similar) is a plus 
Understanding of cloud economics and cost optimization strategies  
Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives, mentor engineers, and drive technical standard 

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

title: Systems Engineer / Solutions Enginer
text:
Job TitleSystems Engineer / Solutions Enginer

Job Description
Your Role
As a Systems Engineer / Solutions Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, integrating, validating, and optimizing complex enterprise IT systems that support healthcare imaging solutions, including PACS and Radiology Informatics.
You will collaborate with R&D, Product Engineering, Architecture, and Customer Support teams to translate business and technical requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing system solutions.
This role requires a strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies, combined with expertise in systems engineering, solution design, technical integration, and problem-solving across complex IT environments.
Key Responsibilities
Systems Design & Architecture: Design and define end-to-end technical solutions for enterprise healthcare imaging systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
Requirements Analysis: Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into system specifications, architecture designs, and integration plans.
Systems Integration: Design, implement, and validate integrations across enterprise infrastructure components, including virtualization, compute, storage, networking, operating systems, and cloud environments.
Solution Engineering: Evaluate technologies, recommend system configurations, define infrastructure sizing, and develop deployment architectures aligned with product and customer requirements.
System Validation & Testing: Participate in system integration testing, performance validation, capacity planning, and reliability assessments to ensure optimal system functionality.
Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement sustainable technical solutions.
Security & Reliability: Ensure system designs comply with security, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements.
Technology Evaluation: Assess emerging technologies, conduct proof-of-concept evaluations, and recommend improvements to existing system architectures.
Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain system architecture diagrams, technical specifications, integration documents, validation plans, and system configuration guidelines.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with global R&D, software engineering, product management, and customer-facing teams throughout the product development and deployment lifecycle.
You're the Right Fit If
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Systems Integration, Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical roles.
Proven experience designing, integrating, and validating complex enterprise IT systems.
Experience translating technical and business requirements into system designs and engineering solutions.
Experience working with enterprise software products and infrastructure technologies.
Exposure to product development lifecycles and collaboration with R&D or engineering teams.
Experience working with global, cross-functional teams.
Technical Skills
Systems Engineering & Integration
Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, solution design, and system integration.
Experience with technical requirements analysis, system configuration, integration testing, and validation.
Knowledge of system scalability, high availability, performance optimization, and disaster recovery.
Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across interconnected systems.
Enterprise Infrastructure Technologies
Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies, particularly VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter.
Good understanding of Windows Server and Linux operating systems.

title: Systems Product Industrialization Engineer
text:
Job TitleSystems Product Industrialization Engineer

Job Description
Systems Product Industrialization Engineer

As an Ultrasound Systems Product Industrialization Engineer, you will help turn new R&D designs into products that can be manufactured safely, consistently, efficiently, and at scale.
You will work directly with R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Test Engineering, and suppliers to bring new Ultrasound Systems into production, implement design and process changes, and remotely help to solve technical problems encountered on the manufacturing floor.

Your Role:

Partner with R&D and Manufacturing to transition new and modified Ultrasound System designs into production.
Evaluate new designs for manufacturability, assembly, testability, process capability, and production risk using DFM/DFA/DfX principles.
Develop and improve manufacturing processes, tooling, equipment, assembly methods, and production documentation.
Plan and execute engineering builds, manufacturing-readiness activities, process validations, Installation Qualifications, and Equipment Qualifications.
Create and maintain Process FMEAs, manufacturing control plans, process requirements, assembly instructions, validation documentation, and other controlled manufacturing records.
Create and release Manufacturing Bills of Materials, routings, and associated manufacturing master data.
Remotely troubleshoot technical issues on production lines and help restore production quickly when manufacturing problems result in line-down conditions.
Perform structured root cause analysis for design, manufacturing, process, quality, yield, and nonconforming-product issues.
Implement approved product and process changes across manufacturing locations and applicable supplier sites.
Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous-improvement methods to reduce waste, simplify processes, improve cycle time, increase yield, and lower manufacturing cost.
Support engineering builds and testing needed to evaluate new products, design changes, and manufacturing processes.
Identify and communicate manufacturing risks to R&D and project teams, including challenging designs or schedules when product quality, manufacturability, safety, or compliance could be compromised.
Ensure manufacturing processes and documentation comply with applicable quality, regulatory, safety, environmental, and company requirements.
Support geographically distributed engineering and manufacturing teams, which will require early-morning or evening collaboration.

You're the Right Fit If:

Bachelor's Degree / Vocational Education in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Sciences, Cost Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Lean Manufacturing, Industrial Automation or equivalent.

Experience of 4 years or academic exposure to manufacturing engineering, Lean Manufacturing, Process FMEA, process validation, root cause analysis, DFM/DFA/DfX, engineering change control, manufacturing documentation, or cost analysis is beneficial. 

Qualifications:

We are looking for an early-career engineer who combines solid engineering fundamentals curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

The successful candidate will:

Apply analytical thinking and engineering fundamentals to solve well-defined manufacturing problems.
Take ownership of assigned problems and drive them through resolution rather than waiting for step-by-step direction.
Know when to work independently and when an issue should be escalated or additional expertise is needed.
Be comfortable troubleshooting problems directly in a manufacturing environment.
Learn unfamiliar products, processes, and technologies quickly.
Produce clear, accurate, and professional engineering documentation.
Communicate technical issues effectively with both engineering and manufacturing audiences.
Work effectively across different functions, personalities, cultures, locations, and time zones.
